charts.title: TOI-5108 b: orbits around TOI-5108
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-5108's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-5108 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Thomas et al. 2025 (2025A&A...694A.143T), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname THOMAS_ET_AL_2025): P 6.753581 d

charts.title: TOI-5108 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-5108 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 350348197, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 9-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
